Teenagers’ Malai Non-Padded Bra – Soft, Lightweight & Comfortable Everyday Wear Lingerie, Plain Design in Beige, Sizes 28, 30, 32

Designed especially for teenagers, this Malai Non-Padded Bra offers the perfect blend of comfort and simplicity. Made from high-quality malai fabric, it feels soft and breathable on the skin, making it ideal for daily wear. Its plain design ensures a smooth look under clothes, while the lightweight material provides ease of movement and all-day freshness. Available in sizes 28, 30, and 32, this bra is tailored to meet the needs of growing teens, offering gentle support without any added padding. The beige shade makes it versatile to wear under any outfit.
